ideas.title: Anti-Failure Triage & No-Progress Circuit Breaker
ideas.problem: Coding agents fail on 45% of complex tasks due to looping on repetitive errors, over-planning simple fixes, or self-verifying buggy code.
ideas.mechanism: 3-Tier Path Triage (Direct/Light/Roadmap) + Error Fingerprint Circuit Breaker + Negative Falsification
ideas.gap: Original repo was 283MB of MSYS/Node source tarballs and rigid external process wrappers that tripled latency.
ideas.adaptation: Distill the 4 core reasoning mechanisms into ponytail and socratic with zero external dependencies, replacing 283MB of Lima VM/Node daemon bloat with pure agent behavioral heuristics.
ideas.constraint: Zero dependencies, pure Python/markdown, sub-millisecond execution, fits inside existing Antigravity skills.
ideas.expected_value: Eliminates repetitive infinite loops and fake-green test verification while keeping small fixes instantaneous.
